scope.scopeNote: The149 reviewed tasks include originals, selected follow-ups and dependency endpoints. Cumulative catalogue totals are not a claim that all361 bank questions were newly reviewed in this release.

behaviours: No-answer check remains blocked without revealing a solution.
Every original and chosen follow-up is answered, checked, reviewed, hinted and retried; exhausted pools stop offering further candidates.
Every hint is revealed individually; returning to the question, redo, next and complete-paper scores work.
A wrong first answer followed by successful practice finishes at0/20 first and20/20 after practice.
Reload/resume, numbered second attempts and stale previous-frame messages are checked.

checks: No selected answer cannot reveal solution or invent an attempt
Hint before answering keeps first independent score zero and recovery one
Actual assessed concepts receive 50% for a correct answer with hints; no other concepts credited
Manager read-only view matches actual 50% concept evidence without importing or modifying answers
Actual public pair Archive/Restore and Remove from my list/Restore persist across reload and retain exact answers, history and both public papers
Reload of unfinished actual attempt preserves saved answers, score, hint use, edition and position exactly
Correct independent answer shows full knowledge recap and later hint recap does not remove its first credit
Account replacement clears actual public frame and incoming answers; old frame cannot contaminate the new account
capabilities.environment: Actual current parent and paper scripts with isolated local account snapshots and synthetic manager responses. No real authentication or production service requests.

checks: Previously published old HTML remains loaded for an ongoing attempt after a new edition becomes the default.
Old concept percentages, answer logs and archived history remain unchanged.
Starting attempt2 uses the newly reviewed edition, while stale attempt1 iframe messages are rejected.
The preview remains excluded from concept analytics, and that empty result is preserved.
historicalEditionRuntime.environment: Actual old and new HTML in local browser fixtures; no production records.

changedTeachingBrowser.coverage: Changed original/follow-up teaching and changed follow-up pools across16 renewed official papers, both interfaces and widths.
changedTeachingBrowser.exactHashReuse: All416 successful changed-teaching browser views from the prior build refer to byte-identical final legacy HTML. Every recorded target and run hash was rechecked against the final immutable manifests. No prior failing or changed-hash evidence is reused.

sourceImageDisplay.captureNote: Full-height viewport captures avoid Chromium fullPage scrollbar cropping. Normal-height layout geometry is checked separately; dense mobile source crops can be enlarged.

presentationChange.scope: The immutable-edition compiler reuses the previously tested MathML sizing helper and known CSS rules when producing new editions from legacy originals. Previously published HTML stays untouched. Responsive source-image wrappers were applied to12 newly cropped Paper2 originals; the source image bytes stay unchanged.

resolvedBeforeRelease.finding: Twelve freshly cropped Paper2 originals lacked the established responsive and accessible source-image wrapper.
resolvedBeforeRelease.resolution: The author corrected the wrapper, independent content QA reapproved exact fingerprints, and both papers were rebuilt from the clean baseline. All8 complete UI traversals and160 source-image cases pass on final hashes.

resolvedBeforeRelease.finding: Six legacy layout tests measured immediately before the asynchronous MathML wrapper completed.
resolvedBeforeRelease.resolution: Exact reproduction showed no persistent overflow after two animation frames. The three test files now wait for fonts and those frames, retaining every overflow assertion and adding horizontal-scroll reachability checks. All363 Node tests pass.

resolvedBeforeRelease.finding: Historical fixture initially expected concept evidence for the preview.
resolvedBeforeRelease.resolution: The preview is intentionally excluded from analytics. The fixture now asserts its empty analytics remain empty while retaining all old-state, history and edition checks;68 configurations pass.

passed: Mathematical content, cumulative hints, assessed concepts and exact relationship reviews for the stated release scope.
Actual new-paper and renewed-teaching UI with normal/Pearson views, mobile/desktop widths, full solutions, hints, retries and follow-ups.
Local-fixture scoring, current and historical edition pinning, numbered attempts, reload, stale-message rejection, account separation and manager read-only presentation.
Every implemented public-roadmap Archive, Remove from my list and Restore flow, including reload and preservation of answers/history/content.
Build, content gates, mapping gates, player checks and all Node/Python suites.
unsupported: No automatic authenticated preparation worker consumes uploaded PDFs; this release does not claim that queue is connected.
Private source-PDF deletion/restoration controls are not supplied by this public-pair release. Public-roadmap hide/restore is reversible and never deletes teaching content or attempts.
unverified: Live logins, real cloud account permissions, manager/student production credentials and cross-device sync were not exercised.
Real Safari, Firefox, native iOS and Android devices were not tested; mobile evidence uses Chromium viewport fixtures.
GitHub Pages deployment is a later publication check, outside this pre-push report.

followupAvailability.reason: Only defensible reviewed matches were retained. Some originals have fewer than three, including none where no close official match was found. Exact per-question gaps are recorded in content/followup-audits.json. No unrelated filler was added.

deferredUnchangedEndpoints.finding: The simultaneous linear exponent equations warrant p1-extra-simultaneous-equations; final reminder currently uses generic factor/cancel/rearrange attribution. Existing common-base and rearrangement concepts remain relevant.
deferredUnchangedEndpoints.disposition: Parent explicitly deferred this unchanged endpoint mapping/reminder improvement to a later audit; no question semantics, saved answers or historical percentages changed here.

deferredUnchangedEndpoints.scope: Unchanged legacy endpoint included only to review removal of its old link; it is not a new question or new follow-up in this pair.
deferredUnchangedEndpoints.finding: The second hint reminder says to evaluate an integral before optimising its parameter but cites p1-b2-l05. A later immutable teaching correction should attach the integration part to p1-b1-l20 or express the quadratic optimisation reminder under p1-b1-l03. Mathematics and final answer A are correct.

sourceErrataHandled.finding: The official option omits c=0. Existing teaching retains published A for assessment but clearly derives the full condition m>0,c≥0,4mc<1 and identifies the missing boundary case.
Independently evaluated stationary heights254 and−194; repaired teaching values are used rather than copying an official intermediate arithmetic typo.

result: No unresolved blocker in this release scope. Tests and content review provide evidence for these exact files, not a guarantee of an examination result.
